items.name: Caveman Cubing Lohja 2025
items.information: Welcome to the lowest elevation WCA competition 100 meters below ground! Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. The competition venue is in a mine accessible by a 22 second elevator ride. There are no toilets or drinking water in the venue, but the visitor center on the surface has both available. Temperature in the mine is 6-8 °C and very humid. The venue is a separate room heated to 20 °C. You will receive a helmet and wearing it is mandatory in the mine, but it can be removed once at the venue. Bring your own lunch and drinks. Tervetuloa maailman syvimpään WCA-kilpailuun 100 metriä maanpinnan alla! Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Kilpailupaikka sijaitsee kaivoksessa, johon pääsee 22 sekunnin hissikyydillä. Kilpailupaikalla ei ole vessoja tai juomavettä, mutta molempiin on pääsy maan pinnalla vierailijakeskuksessa. Lämpötila kaivoksessa on 6-8 °C ja ilmankosteus korkea. Kilpailupaikka on 20 °C lämmitetty erillinen tila. Saat lainaan kypärän, jonka käyttö kaivoksessa on pakollista. Voit riisua kypärän kisapaikalla. Tuo mukana omat eväät ja juomat.

items.name: Dreht's Eich in Ergolding 2025
items.information: **Richtigs Deitsch** Griaß eich mitanand! Seid's recht herzlich willkomm'n bei der **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – da urboarischen Cubing-Competition, wo ned bloß d'Würfel, sondern aa d’Hirnwindung'n auf Hochtour'n laffa! Ob 3x3, 3BLD oder 7x7 – bei uns werd g'dreht, dass da Gummi glüht! Ganz egal, ob's no Anfänger seids, olle erfahrene Speedcuber oder einfach nur zum Zuaschau'n kemmts: Packt's eich zamm, kemmts vorbei und zoagt's, wos in eich steckt – oder lehnt’s eich z'ruck, genießt's de Stimmung und lasst's eich a guade Brezn🥨 schmecka (De miasad's aba seiba kaffa). Mia gfrein uns narrisch auf eich, und denkts dro: **Dreht's eich, aber gscheid!** **English** Hello everyone! A warm welcome to **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – the ultimate Bavarian cubing competition, where not just the cubes, but also your brains will be spinning at full speed! Whether it's 3x3, 3BLD, or 7x7 – we’re turning so fast the rubber’s burning! No matter if you're a beginner, a seasoned speedcuber, or just here to watch: Grab your stuff, come on over, and show us what you've got – or just sit back, soak in the vibe, and enjoy a good pretzel🥨 (you'll have to buy that yourself though). We’re super excited to see you, and don’t forget: **Spin it, and do it right!**

items.information: This competition only has blindfolded and FMC and is not recommended for newcomers. This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Club members are eligible for a discounted registration fee. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQUtahChampionship2025#59108-cubing-club-at-uvu). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
